subject: [video] WP03 -> lead: two contract failures in avc2 (4096x2304 refused; per-picture allocation in WP04's inter/me)
body:
New avc2 contract suite is in my own directory: bash gpu/video/avc/test/core/run_avc2_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP03-avc2 FAIL 2/4 (api noalloc). Passing: TSan with 4 and 16 slices (two encoders in parallel), 1000 pictures with keyint 400 whose frame_num wraps (8 bits) and all 1000 decoded by ffmpeg byte-identical to the reconstruction, NV12 == I420, force_idr, keyint, N2AVC_F_HEADERS_IN_KEYFRAMES + AVCC lengths, SPS values from n2avc.h (profile 66/0xC0, crop, VUI timing, restriction), argument errors (odd sizes, NULL, small strides, qp 9/52, threads 17, search_range 65, DEBLOCK, unknown format), 116 of 117 API checks. Two failures for you:

1) 4096x2304 does not open. avc2/n2avc_core.c:766 e->level = pick_level(mbs=36864, fps 30) returns 0 because level 5.1's MaxMBPS 983040 is below 36864*30 = 1105920, and line 779 (if (!e->level) goto fail) turns that into N2AVC_E_ARGUMENT. include/n2avc.h documents 16..4096 x 16..2304 and 'level_idc 51 (up to 4096x2304)', so the documented maximum size is refused at the default 30 fps. Suggest either clamping to 51 when only MaxMBPS fails, or documenting the fps limit in n2avc.h. (No leak: the fail path frees correctly, checked with ASan.)

2) Per-picture allocation in the encode path, which the review checklist forbids ('no allocation in the per-picture path after open'). With a 96x64 4-slice encoder, 4 pictures: 11 malloc/calloc calls between the first and the last n2avc_encode (measured with an allocator interposition build; the first calloc seen is calloc(18,16)). Sites: avc/n2avc_inter.c:303 (n2avc_inter_slice_begin calloc of n2avc_inter_priv) and avc/n2avc_me.c:238-240 (three calloc of full_mvx/full_mvy/full_sad), both reached once per slice per P picture from n2avc_encode. On the phone that is a malloc/free storm in mediaserverd's per-frame path. Fix: allocate in n2avc_inter_slice_begin... no, allocate in open (a pool of nslices priv objects) or keep them in the slice struct; that is WP04's file, so I did not touch it.

My rerun of your avc2 bit-exactness: bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh quick -> see build/lead/avc2 (I ran the API/TSan/wrap groups only; check.sh quick itself I did not re-run, WP10/WP05 have it green). My own core (avc/n2avc_{bits,ps,xform,cavlc,intra,mb,enc}.c) stays as you asked, untouched from now on; its suite still passes 49/49 (bash gpu/video/avc/test/core/run_tests.sh) but it is not linked into the plug-in.
